dedupe_keys.name: ideihm covam es coastal flood and storm surge hazard datasets

description: ideihm.covam.es: coastal flood and storm surge hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ideihm.covam.es. Coverage: the area served by ideihm.covam.es. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about coastal flood and storm surge hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Servicio de visualización de mapas -Linea de Costa; Servicio de descarga de mapas - Línea de Costa; de Línea de Costa del Reino de España (INSPIRE - HYDROGRAPHY); de Línea de Costa del Reino de España (INSPIRE - SEAREGIONS). Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
